 SPEAK UP: J-pop Takuya Kimura stages shows, K-pop Lisa drops new docu. (1/2) 木村拓哉開唱、Lisa新推紀錄片（上）
 Add TT as Preferred Source 
 A: Japanese superstar Takuya Kimura will perform at the Taipei Music Center this week, while South Korean sensation, Blackpink’s Lisa is heading to Las Vegas, becoming the first K-pop artist to headline a residency in the “Sin City.”
 B: Lisa has also joined the recent wave of music documentaries, releasing her personal documentary “Always Lalisa.” 
 A: Are there any other singers releasing their own documentaries?
 Blackpink’s Lisa at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards. Blackpink Lisa出席MTV音樂錄影帶大獎。
   
Photo: Reuters 照片：路透
 B: Just this year alone, Take That, Billie Eilish, Kylie Minogue, Linkin Park and Oasis have all released music documentaries.
 A: Even though some of these works often more closely resemble “mockumentaries” featuring deliberately staged content, fans still love to watch them. 
 A: 本週日本天王木村拓哉將唱進台北流行音樂中心，而南韓天團Blackpink成員Lisa則將進軍拉斯維加斯，成為在「賭城」駐唱的韓流歌手第一人！
 B: Lisa並搭上歌手紀錄片的風潮，推出個人紀錄片《Always Lalisa》。 
 A: 還有哪些歌手發行紀錄片啊？
 B: 光是今年就有︰接招合唱團、怪奇比莉、凱莉米諾、聯合公園、綠洲合唱團……。 
 A: 雖然這類作品有些比較像「偽紀錄片」，部分內容可能是刻意設計的，不過粉絲還是很愛看。 
 （By Eddy Chang, Taipei Times／台北時報張迪）

Despite its ecological importance, the leopard cat is facing a severe survival crisis. In Taiwan, it is classified as an endangered species, with only an estimated 500 to 700 individuals remaining in the wild. Most of the surviving population is concentrated in the low-altitude hills of Miaoli, Taichung and Nantou counties. 
The greatest threat to the leopard cat is habitat loss and fragmentation caused by human development, including the construction of roads, golf courses and residential areas. As their territory becomes increasingly fragmented, leopard cats are often forced to cross busy roads in search of food or suitable habitats.

 BOOKMAN BILINGUAL 雙語書林: The Dos and Don’ts of English 英語的對與錯
 2026-11-09 
 1. 他的健康已有好轉。 
ˇ His health has taken a turn for the better. 
χ His health has taken a turn for better. 
註：to turn/change for the better/worse, a turn/change for the better/worse 都是慣用語。 
2. 徑賽次序如下： 
ˇ The order of track events is as follows: 
χ The order of track events is as follow: 
註：不論主詞是複數或單數，「如下」都用 as follows，不用 as follow。例如： 
The program is as follows. 
The items are as follows. 
也可以說： 
The items follow. 
The program follows. 
The following is the program. 
The following are the items. 
3. 要做到這一切，精通商用英語是極有必要的。 
ˇ For this, a good command of business English is more than necessary. 
χ For these, a good command of business English is more than necessary. 
註：總結上文時，「這一切」應說 for this，不說 for
